<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações's "Apagar conta" is a dead action — no confirmation dialog, no `DELETE /account` call (epic-8-context.md Story 8.5; FR-43, RNF05, LGPD).

**Approach:** Add a destructive-styled `ConfirmationDialog` (red title/confirm button, `Cancelar` outline) triggered by a new "Apagar conta" button; on confirm, `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()` calls the new `AccountSettingsRepository.deleteAccount()` (`DELETE /account`), then reuses `logout()`'s existing lock+logout+clear sequence (extracted into a shared private helper) — same post-action destination as Story 8.4 (FR-42), no new navigation code.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `ConfirmationDialog` gains optional `confirmButtonColor` (null → `colorPrimary`, unchanged default) and `cancelLabel`/`onCancel` (both null together → no cancel button, exact current session-expiry shape preserved). `AppButton` gains optional `backgroundColor`, consulted only for `AppButtonVariant.primary` (mirrors `textColor`'s existing "only consulted for textGhost" convention), null → `colorPrimary`.
- "Apagar conta": `AppButtonVariant.textGhost` + `textColor: colorError`, the scroll column's last child after "Sair" (prototype-extract.md:116). Disabled while `isDeletingAccount`.
- Tap opens `ConfirmationDialog` (title `'Apagar sua conta?'`, message on permanent/irreversible LGPD deletion, `titleColor`/`confirmButtonColor: colorError`, `barrierColor: colorScrimHeavy`, `confirmLabel: 'Apagar tudo'`, `cancelLabel: 'Cancelar'`) — reuses the same focus-trap/single-overlay widget session-expiry already uses (epic-8-context.md).
- `onCancel` pops the dialog only, no network call. `onConfirm` pops the dialog synchronously, then calls `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()`.
- `AccountSettingsRepository.deleteAccount()`/`_Impl` → `AccountRemoteDataSource.deleteAccount()` → `ApiClient.delete('account-delete', data: {'confirmation': 'DELETE'})`, success mapped to `Right(unit)` (response body unused).
- `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()`: guard re-entry via new `isDeletingAccount` (mirrors `isLoggingOut`). `Left` → reset `isDeletingAccount`, set `deleteAccountErrorMessage: failure.message` (inline, `colorError`, below the button — same convention as the biometric toggle's `errorMessage`, announced via the existing `_announce` + `BlocListener` pattern). `Right` → run the same lock+session-logout+cache-clear sequence `logout()` already performs, extracted into a shared private `_finishSession()` called by both (closes spec-8-4-logout.md's own Design Notes directive).
- No navigation code: the existing `app_router.dart` redirect (already watching `VaultStatus`/`SessionStatus`) lands on `/vault` once `_finishSession()` relocks — identical to Story 8.4.

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** a dedicated "account deleted" screen (none exists; same destination as logout, prototype-extract.md:41,197); an undo/grace-period flow; auto-retrying a failed `DELETE /account`; changing `app_router.dart`; changing `ConfirmationDialog`'s single-overlay guard.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Tap "Apagar conta" | `isDeletingAccount: false` | destructive dialog opens (red title + "Apagar tudo", outline "Cancelar") | N/A |
| Tap "Cancelar" | dialog open | dialog closes, no network call, screen unchanged | N/A |
| Tap "Apagar tudo" | dialog open | dialog closes immediately; `account-delete` fires; on success vault relocks -> redirect to `/vault`; tokens + both Hive caches clear | N/A |
| `account-delete` fails (offline/expired/...) | any | dialog already closed; inline red error below "Apagar conta"; vault stays unlocked, nothing cleared | `Left.message` shown (unlike logout's swallowed failure) |
| Double-tap "Apagar conta" | `isDeletingAccount: true` | second tap no-ops (button disabled) | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/account/domain/repositories/account_settings_repository.dart:76-82` -- add `deleteAccount()` before `dispose()`
- `lib/features/account/data/repositories/account_settings_repository_impl.dart:182-215` -- implement `deleteAccount()` before `dispose()`
- `lib/features/account/data/datasources/account_remote_data_source.dart:31-53` -- add `deleteAccount()` (`_apiClient.delete('account-delete', data: {'confirmation': 'DELETE'})`)
- `lib/features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart:16-158,340-397` -- state fields `isDeletingAccount`/`deleteAccountErrorMessage`; extract `_finishSession()` from `logout()`; add `deleteAccount()`
- `lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart:569-584` -- "Apagar conta" trigger + inline error, after "Sair"; dialog builder
- `lib/core/widgets/confirmation_dialog.dart:18-148` -- `confirmButtonColor`/`cancelLabel`/`onCancel` params + second button in `_Card`
- `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart:18-140` -- `backgroundColor` param, primary variant only
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1820-1840` (`account-delete`, bearerAuth, `{confirmation: 'DELETE'}`) + `README.md:46`
- `docs/input/prototype/cerne-prototype.html` (`askDelete`/`confirmDelete`/`cancelDelete` spans) + `prototype-extract.md:41,114,116`
- `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-8-4-logout.md` Design Notes -- the shared-helper directive this story closes
- Tests: `test/core/widgets/{app_button,confirmation_dialog}_test.dart`, `test/features/account/{data/datasources/account_remote_data_source,data/repositories/account_settings_repository_impl,presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit,presentation/screens/account_settings_screen}_test.dart`

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `app_button.dart` -- add `backgroundColor` (primary-only)
- [x] `confirmation_dialog.dart` -- add `confirmButtonColor`/`cancelLabel`/`onCancel`
- [x] `account_remote_data_source.dart` -- `deleteAccount()`
- [x] `account_settings_repository.dart`/`_impl.dart` -- `deleteAccount()`
- [x] `account_settings_cubit.dart` -- `isDeletingAccount`/`deleteAccountErrorMessage`, `_finishSession()` extraction, `deleteAccount()`
- [x] `account_settings_screen.dart` -- "Apagar conta" button, dialog wiring, inline error
- [x] Tests: I/O matrix + new unit coverage; extend `AppButton`/`ConfirmationDialog` fixtures for the new params

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given Configurações, when "Apagar conta" is tapped, then the destructive-variant dialog appears with a red title (epics.md Story 8.5 AC).
- Given the dialog, when "Apagar tudo" is confirmed, then `DELETE /account` fires and, on success, the account/data are gone and the user lands on the same destination as logout.
- Given "Cancelar" is tapped, then no network call fires and the screen is unchanged.

## Design Notes

`AppButton`'s primary-variant pressed-state overlay stays `colorPrimaryPressed` even when `backgroundColor` overrides the fill to `colorError` — the prototype's static mockup defines no distinct pressed-red value, and design_tokens.dart has none either; inventing one would violate "never hardcode a visual value outside design_tokens.dart." Accepted as a cosmetic, sub-200ms imperfection, not a blocking gap.

`deleteAccount()`'s success path still calls `_sessionRepository.logout()` (POST `auth-logout`) after the account is already server-side deleted — harmless and intentional: it's the same shared `_finishSession()` Story 8.4 built, and epic-8-context.md explicitly directs reusing it rather than branching.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test test/core/widgets test/features/account test/core/navigation` -- expected: all pass

105	+## Intent
106	+
107	+**Problem:** Configurações's "Apagar conta" is a dead action — no confirmation dialog, no `DELETE /account` call (epic-8-context.md Story 8.5; FR-43, RNF05, LGPD).
108	+
109	+**Approach:** Add a destructive-styled `ConfirmationDialog` (red title/confirm button, `Cancelar` outline) triggered by a new "Apagar conta" button; on confirm, `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()` calls the new `AccountSettingsRepository.deleteAccount()` (`DELETE /account`), then reuses `logout()`'s existing lock+logout+clear sequence (extracted into a shared private helper) — same post-action destination as Story 8.4 (FR-42), no new navigation code.
110	+
111	+## Boundaries & Constraints
112	+
113	+**Always:**
114	+- `ConfirmationDialog` gains optional `confirmButtonColor` (null → `colorPrimary`, unchanged default) and `cancelLabel`/`onCancel` (both null together → no cancel button, exact current session-expiry shape preserved). `AppButton` gains optional `backgroundColor`, consulted only for `AppButtonVariant.primary` (mirrors `textColor`'s existing "only consulted for textGhost" convention), null → `colorPrimary`.
115	+- "Apagar conta": `AppButtonVariant.textGhost` + `textColor: colorError`, the scroll column's last child after "Sair" (prototype-extract.md:116). Disabled while `isDeletingAccount`.
116	+- Tap opens `ConfirmationDialog` (title `'Apagar sua conta?'`, message on permanent/irreversible LGPD deletion, `titleColor`/`confirmButtonColor: colorError`, `barrierColor: colorScrimHeavy`, `confirmLabel: 'Apagar tudo'`, `cancelLabel: 'Cancelar'`) — reuses the same focus-trap/single-overlay widget session-expiry already uses (epic-8-context.md).
117	+- `onCancel` pops the dialog only, no network call. `onConfirm` pops the dialog synchronously, then calls `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()`.
118	+- `AccountSettingsRepository.deleteAccount()`/`_Impl` → `AccountRemoteDataSource.deleteAccount()` → `ApiClient.delete('account-delete', data: {'confirmation': 'DELETE'})`, success mapped to `Right(unit)` (response body unused).
119	+- `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()`: guard re-entry via new `isDeletingAccount` (mirrors `isLoggingOut`). `Left` → reset `isDeletingAccount`, set `deleteAccountErrorMessage: failure.message` (inline, `colorError`, below the button — same convention as the biometric toggle's `errorMessage`, announced via the existing `_announce` + `BlocListener` pattern). `Right` → run the same lock+session-logout+cache-clear sequence `logout()` already performs, extracted into a shared private `_finishSession()` called by both (closes spec-8-4-logout.md's own Design Notes directive).
120	+- No navigation code: the existing `app_router.dart` redirect (already watching `VaultStatus`/`SessionStatus`) lands on `/vault` once `_finishSession()` relocks — identical to Story 8.4.
121	+
122	+**Ask First:** None.
123	+
124	+**Never:** a dedicated "account deleted" screen (none exists; same destination as logout, prototype-extract.md:41,197); an undo/grace-period flow; auto-retrying a failed `DELETE /account`; changing `app_router.dart`; changing `ConfirmationDialog`'s single-overlay guard.

   summary: The profile e-mail `Text`'s `maxLines: 1`/`overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis` fix (spec-8-3's own fix) has no dedicated test with a long e-mail string, unlike its sibling display-name overflow fix which has one.
   evidence: Review finding (verification-gap layer). Pre-existing spec-8-3 fix, not introduced by spec-8-4; a long-email test mirroring the existing long-display-name test (`account_settings_screen_test.dart`) would close this.
+
+## Deferred from: code review of spec-8-4-logout (2026-11-08)
+
+- source_spec: `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-8-4-logout.md`
+  summary: `SessionRepositoryImpl.logout()` swallows a `clearSession()` exception with an empty `catch (_) {}` and no logging, while the cache-clear failures a few lines away in the same logout flow (`AccountSettingsCubit.logout()`) do `debugPrint`.
+  evidence: Review finding (blind-hunter layer), reclassified from Patch to Defer after inspection. The silent catch deliberately mirrors `restoreSession()`'s own pre-existing identical silent-catch convention in this same file (its own comment cites it) — adding `debugPrint` here would deviate from that established, intentional match rather than fix a defect. A codebase-wide tension between two valid local conventions (this file's silent-catch vs. the cubit layer's debugPrint-on-failure), not a bug this diff introduced. `session_repository_impl.dart:183`.
+- source_spec: `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-8-4-logout.md`
+  summary: The "Sair" button shows no loading indicator while `isLoggingOut` is true (just `onPressed: null`) — every other in-flight async action on this screen (name save, biometric toggle) shows a `CircularProgressIndicator`.
+  evidence: Review finding (blind-hunter layer), reclassified from Patch to Defer after inspection. `AppButton` is a shared primitive reused across login/signup/entries/vault with no loading-slot API; adding one here means either changing that shared widget (out of this story's scope) or a layout change that can't be visually verified (no simulator/device in this project yet). Low-impact in practice since the vault-lock-triggered redirect fires near-instantly. `account_settings_screen.dart:577`.
+- source_spec: `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-8-4-logout.md`
+  summary: `EntriesRepository.clearLocalCache()`/`ChatRepository.clearLocalCache()` use `Failure.malformedResponse` for local Hive disk-clear failures — a type named for malformed network responses, not local-storage faults.
+  evidence: Review finding (acceptance-auditor + blind-hunter layers, converged). Mirrors an existing convention already used elsewhere in the codebase; fixing it means a broader `Failure`-taxonomy change outside this story's scope. `entries_repository_impl.dart:234`, `chat_repository_impl.dart:163`.
+- source_spec: `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-8-4-logout.md`
+  summary: The vault locks and the router can redirect to `/vault` before the awaited `auth-logout` call and the two `clearLocalCache()` calls finish; if the OS kills the app in that window, the backend session may stay un-revoked and/or the Hive caches unflushed.
+  evidence: Review finding (blind-hunter layer). Generic mobile async-during-navigation risk, not unique to this story's design, and out of scope to mitigate here (would need background-task handling). `account_settings_cubit.dart:348-358`.
+- source_spec: `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-8-4-logout.md`
+  summary: `AccountSettingsCubit.logout()` doesn't guard against `toggleBiometric`/`confirmEditingName` being in flight when "Sair" is tapped — a resolved in-flight call can `emit()` after logout, stomping state with results computed before the session ended.
+  evidence: Review finding (edge-case-hunter layer). Same root cause and risk class as this file's own "logout never resets in-memory singleton state" entry above; not fixable without the broader in-memory-reset decision already explicitly scoped out of this story's frozen Boundaries. `account_settings_cubit.dart:209-235`.
+- source_spec: `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-8-4-logout.md`
+  summary: No real-DI (`sl<...>()`-resolved) e2e test exists yet for the logout orchestration end-to-end, unlike biometric-toggle/name-edit's own `account_settings_flow_e2e_test.dart` coverage.
+  evidence: Review finding (blind-hunter layer, verified against the real test files). A fakes-based router test (`pumpWithLogoutFakesAndVaultGate` in `account_settings_screen_test.dart`) already proves the lock-before-redirect ordering, so this is a coverage-depth gap, not a correctness gap. `test/features/account/account_settings_flow_e2e_test.dart`.

+## Intent
+
+**Problem:** Configurações's "Apagar conta" is a dead action — no confirmation dialog, no `DELETE /account` call (epic-8-context.md Story 8.5; FR-43, RNF05, LGPD).
+
+**Approach:** Add a destructive-styled `ConfirmationDialog` (red title/confirm button, `Cancelar` outline) triggered by a new "Apagar conta" button; on confirm, `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()` calls the new `AccountSettingsRepository.deleteAccount()` (`DELETE /account`), then reuses `logout()`'s existing lock+logout+clear sequence (extracted into a shared private helper) — same post-action destination as Story 8.4 (FR-42), no new navigation code.
+
+## Boundaries & Constraints
+
+**Always:**
+- `ConfirmationDialog` gains optional `confirmButtonColor` (null → `colorPrimary`, unchanged default) and `cancelLabel`/`onCancel` (both null together → no cancel button, exact current session-expiry shape preserved). `AppButton` gains optional `backgroundColor`, consulted only for `AppButtonVariant.primary` (mirrors `textColor`'s existing "only consulted for textGhost" convention), null → `colorPrimary`.
+- "Apagar conta": `AppButtonVariant.textGhost` + `textColor: colorError`, the scroll column's last child after "Sair" (prototype-extract.md:116). Disabled while `isDeletingAccount`.
+- Tap opens `ConfirmationDialog` (title `'Apagar sua conta?'`, message on permanent/irreversible LGPD deletion, `titleColor`/`confirmButtonColor: colorError`, `barrierColor: colorScrimHeavy`, `confirmLabel: 'Apagar tudo'`, `cancelLabel: 'Cancelar'`) — reuses the same focus-trap/single-overlay widget session-expiry already uses (epic-8-context.md).
+- `onCancel` pops the dialog only, no network call. `onConfirm` pops the dialog synchronously, then calls `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()`.
+- `AccountSettingsRepository.deleteAccount()`/`_Impl` → `AccountRemoteDataSource.deleteAccount()` → `ApiClient.delete('account-delete', data: {'confirmation': 'DELETE'})`, success mapped to `Right(unit)` (response body unused).
+- `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()`: guard re-entry via new `isDeletingAccount` (mirrors `isLoggingOut`). `Left` → reset `isDeletingAccount`, set `deleteAccountErrorMessage: failure.message` (inline, `colorError`, below the button — same convention as the biometric toggle's `errorMessage`, announced via the existing `_announce` + `BlocListener` pattern). `Right` → run the same lock+session-logout+cache-clear sequence `logout()` already performs, extracted into a shared private `_finishSession()` called by both (closes spec-8-4-logout.md's own Design Notes directive).
+- No navigation code: the existing `app_router.dart` redirect (already watching `VaultStatus`/`SessionStatus`) lands on `/vault` once `_finishSession()` relocks — identical to Story 8.4.
+
+**Ask First:** None.
+
+**Never:** a dedicated "account deleted" screen (none exists; same destination as logout, prototype-extract.md:41,197); an undo/grace-period flow; auto-retrying a failed `DELETE /account`; changing `app_router.dart`; changing `ConfirmationDialog`'s single-overlay guard.
+
+## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
+
+| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
+|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
+| Tap "Apagar conta" | `isDeletingAccount: false` | destructive dialog opens (red title + "Apagar tudo", outline "Cancelar") | N/A |
+| Tap "Cancelar" | dialog open | dialog closes, no network call, screen unchanged | N/A |
+| Tap "Apagar tudo" | dialog open | dialog closes immediately; `account-delete` fires; on success vault relocks -> redirect to `/vault`; tokens + both Hive caches clear | N/A |
+| `account-delete` fails (offline/expired/...) | any | dialog already closed; inline red error below "Apagar conta"; vault stays unlocked, nothing cleared | `Left.message` shown (unlike logout's swallowed failure) |
+| Double-tap "Apagar conta" | `isDeletingAccount: true` | second tap no-ops (button disabled) | N/A |

+## Design Notes

+`AppButton`'s primary-variant pressed-state overlay stays `colorPrimaryPressed` even when `backgroundColor` overrides the fill to `colorError` — the prototype's static mockup defines no distinct pressed-red value, and design_tokens.dart has none either; inventing one would violate "never hardcode a visual value outside design_tokens.dart." All three review layers are in. Summary of real, confirmed findings after cross-checking against the actual code:

**Patch (auto-fixing now):**
1. `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()` has no `try`/`finally` around its `_repository.deleteAccount()` await — if it ever threw instead of resolving to `Either`, `isDeletingAccount` would stay `true` forever (same bug class `logout()` was already patched for in spec-8-4).
2. `ConfirmationDialog`'s new `cancelLabel`/`onCancel` pair has no assert that they're supplied together.
3. The spec's own Code Map line citations drifted after implementation (e.g. `account_settings_screen.dart:569-584` now points at unrelated dashboard code, not the "Apagar conta" section).

**Defer (pre-existing/architectural, not blocking):** a cross-button race between "Sair" and "Apagar conta" (same risk class already deferred for toggleBiometric/confirmEditingName in spec-8-4), a stale test-count ledger in `test-summary.md`, and a missing second-reload test for spec-8-4's own dashboard-announce-once fix.

**Rejected as noise:** a false "FR-43 doesn't exist" claim (it does, in `epics.md`), and several findings that just point at pre-existing, already-documented conventions this story faithfully copied rather than new defects.

Fixing the Code Map citations myself now, then re-engaging the implementation subagent for the two real code patches.

---
title: 'Story 8.5: Account Deletion'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-08'
status: 'in-review'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: '45b2dcd7ef5d7e7a5d8434ed4b1cfabbc3df43c4'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações's "Apagar conta" is a dead action — no confirmation dialog, no `DELETE /account` call (epic-8-context.md Story 8.5; FR-43, RNF05, LGPD).

**Approach:** Add a destructive-styled `ConfirmationDialog` (red title/confirm button, `Cancelar` outline) triggered by a new "Apagar conta" button; on confirm, `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()` calls the new `AccountSettingsRepository.deleteAccount()` (`DELETE /account`), then reuses `logout()`'s existing lock+logout+clear sequence (extracted into a shared private helper) — same post-action destination as Story 8.4 (FR-42), no new navigation code.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `ConfirmationDialog` gains optional `confirmButtonColor` (null → `colorPrimary`, unchanged default) and `cancelLabel`/`onCancel` (both null together → no cancel button, exact current session-expiry shape preserved). `AppButton` gains optional `backgroundColor`, consulted only for `AppButtonVariant.primary` (mirrors `textColor`'s existing "only consulted for textGhost" convention), null → `colorPrimary`.
- "Apagar conta": `AppButtonVariant.textGhost` + `textColor: colorError`, the scroll column's last child after "Sair" (prototype-extract.md:116). Disabled while `isDeletingAccount`.
- Tap opens `ConfirmationDialog` (title `'Apagar sua conta?'`, message on permanent/irreversible LGPD deletion, `titleColor`/`confirmButtonColor: colorError`, `barrierColor: colorScrimHeavy`, `confirmLabel: 'Apagar tudo'`, `cancelLabel: 'Cancelar'`) — reuses the same focus-trap/single-overlay widget session-expiry already uses (epic-8-context.md).
- `onCancel` pops the dialog only, no network call. `onConfirm` pops the dialog synchronously, then calls `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()`.
- `AccountSettingsRepository.deleteAccount()`/`_Impl` → `AccountRemoteDataSource.deleteAccount()` → `ApiClient.delete('account-delete', data: {'confirmation': 'DELETE'})`, success mapped to `Right(unit)` (response body unused).
- `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()`: guard re-entry via new `isDeletingAccount` (mirrors `isLoggingOut`). `Left` → reset `isDeletingAccount`, set `deleteAccountErrorMessage: failure.message` (inline, `colorError`, below the button — same convention as the biometric toggle's `errorMessage`, announced via the existing `_announce` + `BlocListener` pattern). `Right` → run the same lock+session-logout+cache-clear sequence `logout()` already performs, extracted into a shared private `_finishSession()` called by both (closes spec-8-4-logout.md's own Design Notes directive).
- No navigation code: the existing `app_router.dart` redirect (already watching `VaultStatus`/`SessionStatus`) lands on `/vault` once `_finishSession()` relocks — identical to Story 8.4.

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** a dedicated "account deleted" screen (none exists; same destination as logout, prototype-extract.md:41,197); an undo/grace-period flow; auto-retrying a failed `DELETE /account`; changing `app_router.dart`; changing `ConfirmationDialog`'s single-overlay guard.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Tap "Apagar conta" | `isDeletingAccount: false` | destructive dialog opens (red title + "Apagar tudo", outline "Cancelar") | N/A |
| Tap "Cancelar" | dialog open | dialog closes, no network call, screen unchanged | N/A |
| Tap "Apagar tudo" | dialog open | dialog closes immediately; `account-delete` fires; on success vault relocks -> redirect to `/vault`; tokens + both Hive caches clear | N/A |
| `account-delete` fails (offline/expired/...) | any | dialog already closed; inline red error below "Apagar conta"; vault stays unlocked, nothing cleared | `Left.message` shown (unlike logout's swallowed failure) |
| Double-tap "Apagar conta" | `isDeletingAccount: true` | second tap no-ops (button disabled) | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

entries.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

to.description: Recipient: a name from ListAgents (append its " [ref]" only when a listing or an error shows one), a teammate name, "main", or a background agent's agentId

summary.description: A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row (not transmitted — the recipient previews the first line of `message`). Truncated to 200 characters rather than rejected.

message.description: Plain text message content. The recipient's human sees only the FIRST LINE as a one-line preview until they expand it, so make the first line a clear, self-contained sentence saying what this is about — not a greeting, preamble, or bare @-mention.

notify_when_idle.description: Ask a session ON THIS MACHINE to send you ONE notice when it next goes idle (finishes its turn with nothing queued) or exits — opt-in, one-shot, no polling. With a message: deliver it now AND subscribe. Without a message (omit it): a pure subscription that costs the other session nothing.

input.message:
Code review of your spec-8-5-account-deletion.md implementation found two real, trivially-fixable bugs. Please apply both patches now, then re-run `fvm flutter analyze` and `fvm flutter test test/core/widgets test/features/account test/core/navigation`, and confirm both are clean.

1. `lib/features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart` — `deleteAccount()` has no `try`/`finally` around its own async work, unlike `logout()` (which you correctly wrapped). If `await _repository.deleteAccount()` ever throws instead of resolving to an `Either` (or if anything between the emit and the final state-settle throws), `isDeletingAccount` stays `true` forever, permanently disabling the "Apagar conta" button — this is the exact bug class the existing `logout()`/`finally` guard already protects against (see the comment there: "guarantees `isLoggingOut` resets even if an unexpected throw escapes the chain above"). Fix: restructure `deleteAccount()` so the entire body from the initial `emit(isDeletingAccount: true, ...)` through to completion is covered by a `try`/`finally` that unconditionally resets `isDeletingAccount` to `false` (respecting the existing `isClosed` guards and the fact that the failure branch already sets its own `deleteAccountErrorMessage`, and the success branch already runs `_finishSession()` — the `finally` should not clobber a `deleteAccountErrorMessage` that the failure branch just set, and should not fire if the success branch's own inner `try/finally` around `_finishSession()` already reset the flag). The cleanest shape: wrap the whole method body in one outer `try { ... } finally { if (!isClosed) emit(state.copyWith(isDeletingAccount: false)); }`, and remove the now-redundant inner emits of `isDeletingAccount: false` from the two branches (keep the inner `try/finally` around `_finishSession()` only for its own unrelated-throw safety, or simplify if the outer finally already covers it — your judgment on the minimal clean shape, as long as the end state is: any throw, anywhere in this method, still leaves `isDeletingAccount: false`).

2. `lib/core/widgets/confirmation_dialog.dart` — `ConfirmationDialog`'s `cancelLabel`/`onCancel` constructor params have no `assert` enforcing they're supplied together (currently the `_Card` only renders the cancel button when `cancelLabel != null && onCancel != null`, so a future caller passing only one silently loses the cancel button instead of failing loudly). Add `assert((cancelLabel == null) == (onCancel == null), 'cancelLabel and onCancel must be supplied together')` to the `ConfirmationDialog` constructor.

After both are fixed and verification passes, update `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-8-5-account-deletion.md`'s Tasks & Acceptance / status is already handled by me — you don't need to touch the spec file's frontmatter or task checkboxes, just report back what you changed in the two Dart files and the verification output.

title: 'Story 8.5: Account Deletion'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-08'
status: 'in-review'
review_loop_iteration: 0

baseline_commit: '45b2dcd7ef5d7e7a5d8434ed4b1cfabbc3df43c4'

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações's "Apagar conta" is a dead action — no confirmation dialog, no `DELETE /account` call (epic-8-context.md Story 8.5; FR-43, RNF05, LGPD).

**Approach:** Add a destructive-styled `ConfirmationDialog` (red title/confirm button, `Cancelar` outline) triggered by a new "Apagar conta" button; on confirm, `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()` calls the new `AccountSettingsRepository.deleteAccount()` (`DELETE /account`), then reuses `logout()`'s existing lock+logout+clear sequence (extracted into a shared private helper) — same post-action destination as Story 8.4 (FR-42), no new navigation code.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `ConfirmationDialog` gains optional `confirmButtonColor` (null → `colorPrimary`, unchanged default) and `cancelLabel`/`onCancel` (both null together → no cancel button, exact current session-expiry shape preserved). `AppButton` gains optional `backgroundColor`, consulted only for `AppButtonVariant.primary` (mirrors `textColor`'s existing "only consulted for textGhost" convention), null → `colorPrimary`.
- "Apagar conta": `AppButtonVariant.textGhost` + `textColor: colorError`, the scroll column's last child after "Sair" (prototype-extract.md:116). Disabled while `isDeletingAccount`.
- Tap opens `ConfirmationDialog` (title `'Apagar sua conta?'`, message on permanent/irreversible LGPD deletion, `titleColor`/`confirmButtonColor: colorError`, `barrierColor: colorScrimHeavy`, `confirmLabel: 'Apagar tudo'`, `cancelLabel: 'Cancelar'`) — reuses the same focus-trap/single-overlay widget session-expiry already uses (epic-8-context.md).
- `onCancel` pops the dialog only, no network call. `onConfirm` pops the dialog synchronously, then calls `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()`.
- `AccountSettingsRepository.deleteAccount()`/`_Impl` → `AccountRemoteDataSource.deleteAccount()` → `ApiClient.delete('account-delete', data: {'confirmation': 'DELETE'})`, success mapped to `Right(unit)` (response body unused).
- `AccountSettingsCubit.deleteAccount()`: guard re-entry via new `isDeletingAccount` (mirrors `isLoggingOut`). `Left` → reset `isDeletingAccount`, set `deleteAccountErrorMessage: failure.message` (inline, `colorError`, below the button — same convention as the biometric toggle's `errorMessage`, announced via the existing `_announce` + `BlocListener` pattern). `Right` → run the same lock+session-logout+cache-clear sequence `logout()` already performs, extracted into a shared private `_finishSession()` called by both (closes spec-8-4-logout.md's own Design Notes directive).
- No navigation code: the existing `app_router.dart` redirect (already watching `VaultStatus`/`SessionStatus`) lands on `/vault` once `_finishSession()` relocks — identical to Story 8.4.

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** a dedicated "account deleted" screen (none exists; same destination as logout, prototype-extract.md:41,197); an undo/grace-period flow; auto-retrying a failed `DELETE /account`; changing `app_router.dart`; changing `ConfirmationDialog`'s single-overlay guard.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Tap "Apagar conta" | `isDeletingAccount: false` | destructive dialog opens (red title + "Apagar tudo", outline "Cancelar") | N/A |
| Tap "Cancelar" | dialog open | dialog closes, no network call, screen unchanged | N/A |
| Tap "Apagar tudo" | dialog open | dialog closes immediately; `account-delete` fires; on success vault relocks -> redirect to `/vault`; tokens + both Hive caches clear | N/A |
| `account-delete` fails (offline/expired/...) | any | dialog already closed; inline red error below "Apagar conta"; vault stays unlocked, nothing cleared | `Left.message` shown (unlike logout's swallowed failure) |
| Double-tap "Apagar conta" | `isDeletingAccount: true` | second tap no-ops (button disabled) | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/account/domain/repositories/account_settings_repository.dart:78-86` -- add `deleteAccount()` before `dispose()`
- `lib/features/account/data/repositories/account_settings_repository_impl.dart:211-214` -- implement `deleteAccount()` before `dispose()`
- `lib/features/account/data/datasources/account_remote_data_source.dart:34-48` -- add `deleteAccount()` (`_apiClient.delete('account-delete', data: {'confirmation': 'DELETE'})`)
- `lib/features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart:16-192,380-477` -- state fields `isDeletingAccount`/`deleteAccountErrorMessage`; extract `_finishSession()` from `logout()`; add `deleteAccount()`
- `lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart:285-319,623-657` -- dialog builder (`_openDeleteAccountDialog`) + "Apagar conta" trigger/inline error, after "Sair"
- `lib/core/widgets/confirmation_dialog.dart:18-148` -- `confirmButtonColor`/`cancelLabel`/`onCancel` params + second button in `_Card`
- `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart:18-140` -- `backgroundColor` param, primary variant only
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1820-1840` (`account-delete`, bearerAuth, `{confirmation: 'DELETE'}`) + `README.md:46`
- `docs/input/prototype/cerne-prototype.html` (`askDelete`/`confirmDelete`/`cancelDelete` spans) + `prototype-extract.md:41,114,116`
- `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-8-4-logout.md` Design Notes -- the shared-helper directive this story closes
- Tests: `test/core/widgets/{app_button,confirmation_dialog}_test.dart`, `test/features/account/{data/datasources/account_remote_data_source,data/repositories/account_settings_repository_impl,presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit,presentation/screens/account_settings_screen}_test.dart`

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `app_button.dart` -- add `backgroundColor` (primary-only)
- [x] `confirmation_dialog.dart` -- add `confirmButtonColor`/`cancelLabel`/`onCancel`
- [x] `account_remote_data_source.dart` -- `deleteAccount()`
- [x] `account_settings_repository.dart`/`_impl.dart` -- `deleteAccount()`
- [x] `account_settings_cubit.dart` -- `isDeletingAccount`/`deleteAccountErrorMessage`, `_finishSession()` extraction, `deleteAccount()`
- [x] `account_settings_screen.dart` -- "Apagar conta" button, dialog wiring, inline error
- [x] Tests: I/O matrix + new unit coverage; extend `AppButton`/`ConfirmationDialog` fixtures for the new params

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given Configurações, when "Apagar conta" is tapped, then the destructive-variant dialog appears with a red title (epics.md Story 8.5 AC).
- Given the dialog, when "Apagar tudo" is confirmed, then `DELETE /account` fires and, on success, the account/data are gone and the user lands on the same destination as logout.
- Given "Cancelar" is tapped, then no network call fires and the screen is unchanged.

## Design Notes

`AppButton`'s primary-variant pressed-state overlay stays `colorPrimaryPressed` even when `backgroundColor` overrides the fill to `colorError` — the prototype's static mockup defines no distinct pressed-red value, and design_tokens.dart has none either; inventing one would violate "never hardcode a visual value outside design_tokens.dart." Accepted as a cosmetic, sub-200ms imperfection, not a blocking gap.

`deleteAccount()`'s success path still calls `_sessionRepository.logout()` (POST `auth-logout`) after the account is already server-side deleted — harmless and intentional: it's the same shared `_finishSession()` Story 8.4 built, and epic-8-context.md explicitly directs reusing it rather than branching.
